description: Get a URL the human can open to view and edit the design you are working on in CE.SDK. Returns the design's stable URL — it follows every change, so print it ONCE and don't re-emit a fresh URL every turn. The page is a full editor; when the human clicks 'Save', their edits land in the same design file. A new design is viewable after its first change. The editor opens in the mode the human last chose for this design, else 'motion' (timeline) when the design has animation, video, audio or timed blocks and 'design' otherwise; pass `mode` to force one. The human can change the design there and save it: your next call says so, and you `preview` their version before you continue.

mode.description: Editor mode to open in: 'motion' shows the timeline and clip tools, 'design' the still-design editor.

name: view
